title: Standing-Series Weekend Rotation Rates — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Route planning schedule: weekend rotation for standing orders

A Saturday or Sunday Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of Specimen Collection Appointments that collects a standing order is served on the standing-series weekend rotation. Whether the order is a standing order, and how many test charges were posted on it in the last six months, are read from the order's records in Laboratory Test Orders (its standing-order flag and the test charge lines on its ledger).

| The order collected | Test charges posted in the last six months | Weekend amount multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Standing order | Six or more | 0.65 |
| Standing order | Three to five | 0.80 |
| Standing order | Fewer than three | Taken as it stands |
| Not a standing order | Any | Taken as it stands |

**Clause.** When the order is a standing order and six or more test charges were posted on it in the last six months, the weekend amount is multiplied by 0.65; when it is a standing order and three to five test charges were posted on it in that window, it is multiplied by 0.80; otherwise it is taken as it stands.

**Readings (hypothetical orders).** Standing order with exactly six charges: 0.65. Standing order with exactly three: 0.80. Standing order with two: as it stands. A one-time order with ten charges: as it stands.
